sections.heading: Is maternity and newborn baby coverage available in this plan?
sections.text: Yes. Maternity coverage is available for sum insured of ₹5 lakh and above, subject to a waiting period. It includes delivery expenses, surrogacy-related costs, complications from assisted reproductive technologies, and newborn care from birth if initiated within 90 days.

sections.heading: Is organ donor treatment covered under this policy?
sections.text: Yes. Medical expenses for organ donor treatment are covered when the insured is the recipient, including hospitalisation and surgery costs for harvesting the organ, up to the sum insured limit.

sections.heading: What are the Sum Insured options available under My Health Care Plan?
sections.text:
Options range from ₹3 lakh to ₹75 lakh and ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore. Available choices include ₹3, ₹4, ₹5, ₹7.5, ₹10, ₹15, ₹20, ₹25, ₹30, ₹35, ₹40, ₹45, ₹50, ₹75 lakh, and ₹1, ₹2, ₹3, ₹4, ₹5 crore.
Can I migrate or port my existing health insurance policy to My Health Care Plan?
Yes. You can port or migrate your existing policy under IRDAI norms. Waiting periods for pre-existing diseases may be credited, provided the previous policy was continuous and underwriting approval is granted.

sections.heading: What is the waiting period under My Health Care Plan?
sections.text: The plan includes a 30-day initial waiting period, a 24-month waiting period for specified diseases/procedures, and a 36-month waiting period for pre-existing conditions, with modification options.

chunks.heading: Is maternity and newborn baby coverage available in this plan?
chunks.text: Yes. Maternity coverage is available for sum insured of ₹5 lakh and above, subject to a waiting period. It includes delivery expenses, surrogacy-related costs, complications from assisted reproductive technologies, and newborn care from birth if initiated within 90 days.

chunks.heading: Is organ donor treatment covered under this policy?
chunks.text: Yes. Medical expenses for organ donor treatment are covered when the insured is the recipient, including hospitalisation and surgery costs for harvesting the organ, up to the sum insured limit.

chunks.heading: What are the Sum Insured options available under My Health Care Plan?
chunks.text:
Options range from ₹3 lakh to ₹75 lakh and ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore. Available choices include ₹3, ₹4, ₹5, ₹7.5, ₹10, ₹15, ₹20, ₹25, ₹30, ₹35, ₹40, ₹45, ₹50, ₹75 lakh, and ₹1, ₹2, ₹3, ₹4, ₹5 crore.
Can I migrate or port my existing health insurance policy to My Health Care Plan?
Yes. You can port or migrate your existing policy under IRDAI norms. Waiting periods for pre-existing diseases may be credited, provided the previous policy was continuous and underwriting approval is granted.

chunks.heading: What is the waiting period under My Health Care Plan?
chunks.text: The plan includes a 30-day initial waiting period, a 24-month waiting period for specified diseases/procedures, and a 36-month waiting period for pre-existing conditions, with modification options.
